prompt_md: A brick weighs 1 kg plus half a brick. How many kilograms does the brick weigh?
prompt_short: A brick weighs 1 kg plus half a brick. Its weight?
hint_md: The other half of the brick weighs what?
explain_intuition_md: If the brick is 1 kg plus half a brick, then the 1 kg must be the other half. Two halves of 1 kg make 2 kg.
